title: Sage movement_profile record
description: A movement_profile record (MovementProfileRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another movement_profile record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

mode.description: Walk, AirStrafe (GoldSrc bunny-hopping), Fly or Noclip; Default = Walk. (MovementMode, default "Walk")

crouchTime.description: Seconds to go from standing to crouched and back; 0 = instant. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0.2)

airStrafeSpeed.description: AirStrafe: the most speed the air acceleration adds along the wish (GoldSrc's 30 units) Unit: m/s. At least 0. (float, default 0.76)

airStrafeAccelerate.description: AirStrafe: GoldSrc's sv_airaccelerate, times the wished speed per second. At least 0. (float, default 10)

flySpeed.description: Fly and Noclip: speed where it looks; Run doubles it. Unit: m/s. At least 0. (float, default 8)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
